summary: Iteration 3 — post-refactor regression: verified backend still boots and all core APIs work after slimming requirements.txt, adding ENVIRONMENT=production fail-fast guards, and CORS wildcard/credentials fix. 12/12 pytest checks pass against the external URL. No ModuleNotFoundError — the trimmed dependency set (fastapi, uvicorn, python-multipart, pydantic, httpx, brotli, motor, pymongo, pyjwt, bcrypt, python-dotenv, stripe, tzdata) is sufficient. Removed packages (boto3, jq, numpy, pandas, passlib, python-jose, requests, requests-oauthlib, typer, email-validator, cryptography) were confirmed unnecessary at runtime. Config refactor is safe.

POST /api/marketplace/listings — creates listing with server-snapshotted market_hash_name, class_id, instance_id (item-substitution defense intact)

critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 3046 lines — should be split into routers (auth, marketplace, orders, admin, stripe, fx) for maintainability. Not blocking.

STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SECRET currently holds a placeholder in .env; documented intent is that when unset the endpoint returns 500 'webhook_not_configured'. With a placeholder value it will attempt signature verification and fail — behaviour is fine but consider explicit placeholder detection to keep the error message accurate.

ENVIRONMENT var defaults to 'development' — the fail-fast guard is correctly gated. In dev env JWT_SECRET is still the committed placeholder 'cs2-market-secret-change-me-9x7q2' (not the raw default 'dev-secret'), so the guard wouldn't fire even if ENVIRONMENT flipped to production — production deploy must override JWT_SECRET regardless.
